cd D:\npqo
$p = 'scripts\screenshots.mjs'
$t = Get-Content -Raw $p
$t = $t -replace 'if \(message\.type\(\) === "error"\) errors\.push\(message\.text\(\)\);', 'if (message.type() === "error" && !message.location().url?.endsWith("/favicon.ico")) { errors.push(message.text()); }'
